name: spinner
summary: Twelve loaders — ring, dots, bars, pulse, orbit, typing, line and more — from one API.
props: Indicator style — 12 loaders. "line" is an indeterminate bar size × 4 wide (override with style.width).
16 / 24 / 36 / 52pt, or any number. Every variant scales from it.
Accessibility label; shown on screen when labelPosition is set.
Show the label beside or under the spinner, with an animated ellipsis.
Faint guide behind the motion: full circle (ring, orbit, arc), rail (line) or ghost bars (bars).
Style for the root view (the square, or the spinner + label row/column).
behavior: Every variant loops on the native driver (rotation, scale, translate, opacity); the ring's arc-length breathing is the only SVG prop animation and runs on its own JS-driven node.
Loops stop and each loader holds a still, clearly-busy frame (staggered dots, a lit diagonal, a mid-line segment); the ring keeps a plain steady spin.
Announced as a progress bar with state busy and your label (default "Loading"); the visual is one accessible element.
Pure React Native Animated plus react-native-svg — iOS, Android, Expo Go and web, no native setup.
